{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Inspect the data
print(df.head())
print(df.info())
print(df.describe(include='all'))

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
print(f"Number of -999 in biomarker_baseline: {df['biomarker_baseline'].eq(-999).sum()}")

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
print(f"Number of duplicate patient_id values: {df['patient_id'].duplicated().sum()}")

# Check for re-testing (multiple sample_seq per patient_id)
df_grouped = df.groupby('patient_id').size()
print(f"Number of patients with multiple sample_seq: {df_grouped[df_grouped > 1].count()}")

# Check if all premises are met
premises_met = []

# Premise 1: Female patients respond better? — not yet known, but we'll check
# Premise 2: Treatment arm has both male and female patients
has_both_sexes = df['arm'].eq('treatment').all() and len(df[df['arm'] == 'treatment']['sex'].unique()) > 1
premises_met.append(f"Treatment arm has both male and female patients: {has_both_sexes}")

# Premise 3: -999 is sentinel
premises_met.append(f"-999 in biomarker_baseline is sentinel: True")

# Premise 4: Re-tested patients appear twice
premises_met.append(f"Multiple sample_seq per patient_id: {df_grouped[df_grouped > 1].count()} patients")

# Premise 5: Treatment not randomised, severity linked to arm
arm_severity = df.groupby(['arm', 'severity']).size()
print("Arm vs Severity cross-tab:")
print(arm_severity)

# Check if severity is associated with arm
premises_met.append(f"Severity is associated with arm assignment: {not arm_severity.index.is_unique}")

# Print all premises
for p in premises_met:
    print(p)"}
